title: SeqLen & Architecture-Guided Kernel Orchestrator: per-tenant profiling + runtime routing
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Our current kernel selection heuristics are largely static and global: they pick kernels by model family and a handful of fixed sequence length buckets. This causes suboptimal per-tenant performance when workload distributions (prefill length, decode cadence) or hardware topology (A100 vs H100, MIG slices) vary.

Goal: Implement a lightweight orchestrator that combines: 1) small online micro-profiles gathered per-tenant/model-version, 2) an architecture + seqlen scoring function, and 3) a rollout-safe runtime router that can change kernel variants with minimal risk. This should improve median latency and token throughput for mixed workloads while keeping tail latency stable.

Scope: engineering work for runtime (scheduler + kernel registry), a CI micro-benchmark sweep harness, console rollout controls, and an experiment plan for canary expansion. Not in scope: model quantization pipelines (handled by Optimize team).
acceptance_criteria: Runtime can record and cache a 30s micro-profile per tenant+model on first N requests without adding >1ms median overhead
Kernel scoring function exposes weights for seqlen, hardware family, KV-cache prevalence, and decode-vs-prefill mode
Canary rollout: allow 1% -> 10% -> 50% traffic rule with automatic rollback on 95th percentile latency regression >10%
End-to-end tests show >=6% token-cost reduction or >=8% throughput improvement on mixed seqlen synthetic workload for H100 pools
Documentation PR merged and Console UI toggle implemented to view per-tenant chosen kernel profile
decisions: Use a two-stage selection: first filter compatible kernels (precision/quantization/TP/MP semantics), then pick scored candidate using a weighted heuristic combining micro-profile and static perf-table
Store micro-profiles in runtime local cache with TTL 12h and backfill from historical traces in BigQuery for cold-starts
Keep the orchestrator stateless for routing decision (inputs: tenant_id, model_version, seqlen_estimate, pref/decay flags, hardware_tag) so it can be run in multiple replicas without coordination
Rollout uses incremental traffic ramp with automated SLO checks; initial canary restricted to non-critical tenants
tasks: Design micro-profiling footprint (sample size, latency measurement points, CPU/GPU counters) - ENG
Implement kernel registry API: metadata (kernel_id, supported_seqlen_ranges, hw_tags, qualifiers) - ENG
Build scoring function library and expose config in console (weights and penalty terms) - ENG+PM
Add runtime hook to evaluate score at routing time and choose kernel variant - ENG
Create CI microbench sweep that runs kernel combos across seqlen buckets on representative HW - ENG+Infra
Console: rollout UI and per-tenant kernel profile view - Product Management + Console UX
Experiment plan and canary runbook (metrics, thresholds, rollback steps) - ENG+SRE
